anche.note: example: 'anche io' is normally elided to anch'io, which would hide the headword; replaced with a sentence where the full form is the only choice

ci.note: definitions and gloss joined two meanings (us / there); kept the first-person-plural pronoun, which is what pos and example show; added person to lexical

su.note: tl_simple added the adverb meaning 'upwards' (a different sense); kept the preposition 'on'

stare.note: definitions joined staying in a place with being in a state, and the gloss added the progressive; 'senza muoversi' was false for a state; kept 'to stay' (first hint, simple gloss) and changed the example to match; added the participle

cosa.note: example used the interrogative 'che cosa' (what), not the noun 'thing'; pronunciation given with /z/ only, changed to the dictionary citation form with /s/

cui.note: lexical note 'always follows a preposition' is false (il cui nome; la persona cui scrivo)

molto (adverb).note: tl_simple said 'almost at the maximum', which is not what molto means

parte.note: tl_standard and gloss joined 'part' with 'side'; kept 'part', which the example shows
